C0980.title: Peacekeeper Elite Penalties for Teaming with Cheaters
C0980.summary: A Peacekeeper Elite enforcement notice dated October 18, 2024 states that the platform penalizes both cheat use and “riding with cheaters,” where players team up with cheating accounts to benefit, and includes such accounts in anti-cheat enforcement. The notice shows that gaming platforms treat collaborative cheating, free-riding gains, and direct cheat use as punishable violations.
